items.quote: you who are in the other two companies that normally go off Sabbath duty are all to guard the temple for the king.
items.contrast: The two companies going off duty were to guard the temple for the king, not the royal palace.
items.reason: The passage directly assigns temple guard duty to the two normally off-duty companies. Guarding the royal palace was assigned instead to one-third of the companies going on duty, so the reader must track which group received which assignment.
